title: Brian Mundubile and Another v Hakainde Hichilema and Another [2025] ZMCC 28 (5 December 2025)
case_name: Brian Mundubile and Another v Hakainde Hichilema and Another
issue_tags: Article 98(1) — presidential immunity from legal proceedings
misjoinder of the President in his personal capacity
Section 3 Official Oaths Act, Chapter 5 of the Laws of Zambia
eligibility of Hakainde Hichilema to contest the next presidential election
Munir Zulu and Anor v Attorney General [2025] ZMCC 12 (cited)
costs against counsel in public-interest litigation
private vs official capacity of the Republican President
outcome_detail: Application by the 2nd Respondent (Attorney General) to strike out the 1st Respondent (President Hakainde Hichilema) from the petition is by and large granted (paragraph [99]). The Court ordered: (a) the 1st Respondent be removed/misjoined from the petition in respect of anything alleged in his private capacity, pursuant to Article 98(1) of the Constitution; (b) the proceedings continue against the 2nd Respondent (Attorney General) as the sole Respondent; (c) parties bear their own respective costs of and incidental to the application. The Attorney General's prayer for costs against petitioners' counsel was declined as setting a bad precedent for lawyer-litigants (paragraphs [96]–[98]).
